posts.content_md:
Can you guys give me some direction..

I deal with alot of athletes and i want to create hologram videos that are stationary where i can produce audio and visual video of athletes to then send to college coaches fir recruiting purposes. 

I have some..money to spend but dont have the first clue where or what to buy. 

Can you guys give a dumb guy some direction?

Thank you in advance

posts.author: Din
posts.content_md: Liti ( [https://www.litiholo.com/](https://www.litiholo.com/) ), or Geola ( [http://geola.com/](http://geola.com/) ) will both make holograms from your video. I believe Jason Sappan ([http://www.holographer.com/](http://www.holographer.com/)) likes to make his own video, but may be able to use your video, or, at least, give you instructions on how to video your events
